crossRefs.note: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.
I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.
Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;
for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;
Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may…
Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,
Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind…
I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.
The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.
From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.
One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,
“Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.

Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ…
Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.
But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.
Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us…

He called for lights, sprang in, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,
I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.
His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you…

translations.web: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
translations.bsb: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.
translations.kjv: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
translations.asv: So then, my beloved, even as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling;
